name: Denise Lite
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Denise Lite is a family law attorney. She is managing partner at DaCorsi Placencio, P.C. The City Council removed her from the Santa Clarita Planning Commission by a 3-2 vote in July 2025 after the requesting council member stated she was unable to reach Lite regarding commission business. Lite said the removal was retaliation for questioning developer deals.

sentences.text: Denise Lite is a family law attorney.
She is managing partner at DaCorsi Placencio, P.C.

The City Council removed her from the Santa Clarita Planning Commission by a 3-2 vote in July 2025 after the requesting council member stated she was unable to reach Lite regarding commission business.
Lite said the removal was retaliation for questioning developer deals.

items.text: Her campaign says she supports transparent governance and responsible development. At an October 2026 candidate forum, Lite said three major road connectors must be built before adding development. She noted the city has approved only a fraction of its state affordable-housing allocation. She supports collaboration with the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department for public safety.
